name: Chicago Toy & Game Fair
blurb: A family consumer toy and game fair in Rosemont, Illinois, the public-facing event inside Chicago Toy & Game (POP) Week.

editions.evidence: Tickets page text: 'CHICAGO TOY & GAME FAIR TICKETS 11/7/2026 - 11/8/2026 ... Join us at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont for the annual Chicago Toy & Game Fair! ... Saturday, November 7th, 10am-6pm Sunday, November 8th 10am-5pm.'

notes: 'POP Week' is the umbrella brand for a cluster of events in Rosemont: the Inventor Pitch & Innovation Conferences, the Young Inventor Challenge and the TAGIE Awards are industry/trade-only, but the 'Chicago Toy & Game Fair' itself is explicitly the consumer-facing show ('Families & People of All Ages to Play'), so it is kept active rather than inactive. The page labels the fair 'Details TBA!' right next to the specific Nov 7-8 dates and hours, which read as the fair's confirmed dates with programming details still pending, not an unconfirmed date range. This is a toy/game trade fair rather than a guest-driven con, so guests is 'none'.
